Welcome to Vital Chiropractic, where real, lasting results come from understanding how your body moves, works, and heals. I’m Dr. Jonathan Shultz, a chiropractor in Austin, Texas, focused on helping active families, outdoor enthusiasts, and hard-working people get out of pain and back to the life they love.

On this channel, you’ll find clear, no-nonsense education about posture, mobility, strength, and the root causes of pain—plus practical tips you can use at home. My approach is simple: honest care, skilled hands, and solutions that fit real life.

If you want to feel better, move better, and stay better, you’re in the right place. Subscribe and start rebuilding your health, one step at a time with Vital Chiropractic.
